name: windy-plugin-snowline-map-100m
description: ECMWF wet-bulb-zero Snowline proxy to +144 h with automatic labels at Windy’s active pointer/picker location, place search, Label only and Label + contour modes, persistent Windy map-elevation probes with a ±100 m near-snowline band, adaptive sampling, caching and decluttered contours.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && SERVE=false rollup -c && cp package.json dist/
scripts.build:win: rmdir /s /q dist && mkdir dist && set SERVE=false && rollup -c && copy package.json dist\
